critical_false_negative.reference_source: No independent human/objective critical mismatch gold in frozen evidence
critical_false_negative.derivation: Requires reference-positive mismatch labels compared with accepted system output.
critical_false_negative.limitations: System output, signature, and ASR transcript are not gold.

wrongly_accepted_critical.reference_source: No independent human/objective critical truth in frozen evidence
wrongly_accepted_critical.derivation: Requires accepted output versus independently adjudicated critical truth.
wrongly_accepted_critical.limitations: A signature match is system evidence, not reference truth.

extractor_critical_error.reference_source: No reviewed/reference knowledge type labels in frozen evidence
extractor_critical_error.derivation: Internal extractor state is retained as diagnostic only; no independent type truth exists.
extractor_critical_error.limitations: The V2.1 inferred taxonomy cannot validate itself.

critical_source_binding_failure.reference_source: Cross-record identity plus recomputed AUDIO/VTT/CLIP bytes
critical_source_binding_failure.derivation: Count critical rows with cross-record conflicts/missing fields or non-verified required bytes.
critical_source_binding_failure.limitations: Duplicate historical rows are canonicalized and reported separately.

text_only_correction_accepted.reference_source: A/B claim comparison plus cross-record and recomputed audio/clip evidence
text_only_correction_accepted.derivation: Count accepted claim changes lacking independently verified audio/clip bytes.
text_only_correction_accepted.limitations: This does not establish semantic correctness of the changed claim.

clean_control_harmful_change.reference_source: Independent semantic/human reference required for changed clean-control claims
clean_control_harmful_change.derivation: A changed clean-control claim is observable; harmfulness needs independent reference truth.
clean_control_harmful_change.limitations: All changed clean controls remain unresolved for semantic harmfulness.
